source_additions.title: The UK Video Games Development Sector Surges Forward

source_additions.notes: Primary public TIGA release for Making Games in the UK Today (2019). It reports both November 2017 and November 2018 endpoints and says the forthcoming report was based on an extensive survey of UK games businesses with Games Investor Consulting analysis.

source_additions.notes: Ukie’s public report page says all results refer to a 2016 snapshot because it reused BFI Screen Business underlying data, and calls the direct company result 16,140 FTE roles. The underlying BFI report was not re-downloaded in this pass.

integration_recommendation: Add the 2011-2014 rows to GB_dcms_jobs only after checking whether the 2026 DCMS release revised any historical values. Preserve its low-trend-eligibility warning and sample uncertainty.
Add November 2017 to the existing GB_tiga_fte and GB_tiga_people series. It is a source-native paired endpoint with the existing November 2018 observations, not an interpolation.

If retained, add GB_ukie_direct_company_fte_2016 as a separate, one-point, non-index-eligible series. Never substitute it for TIGA's 2016 FTE, Ukie's 20,430 broader direct development/publishing/retail figure, or 47,620 supported FTE total.

No new game-only 2026 reference-year employment observation was found. The most recent inspected government release covers 2025, and TIGA's March 2026 public release reports a September 2025 snapshot.
